The company demonstrates some signs of improvement in cash position and solvency.  However, the contraction in operating income and overall decreased profitability, coupled with flat revenue, introduce a degree of concern. The increase in interest expense is also something to watch. While the increased net income is encouraging, the underlying trend in operational performance necessitates caution. Hence a slightly negative sentiment score of -0.2 is assigned, with high confidence in the analysis because of the availability of data.
